quote: “Last year is dead, they seem to say, / Begin afresh, afresh, afresh.”
source: Philip Larkin, The Trees, lines 11 and 12, High Windows (Faber and Faber, 1974)

evidence.where: The Poetry Archive text of The Trees, printed by permission of Faber from Collected Poems (1993); High Windows (1974) is the first book publication
evidence.edition: High Windows (Faber and Faber, 1974); Collected Poems (Faber, 1993)
evidence.locator: lines 11 and 12, the closing couplet of the twelve line poem

reason: The closing couplet of the twelve line poem, in exactly this wording with the line initial capital on Begin; the proposal’s lines 10 to 12 is tightened to 11 and 12. Not shipped, not at cap, not banned.
